questions: Is the goal to maximize the sum of the prices of the K pairs, or to maximize the total price as defined (which is the sum of the prices of the K pairs)?
Are we allowed to leave some cakes unpaired, or must all cakes be used in the pairing?
Should the pairs be disjoint (each cake used at most once), or can a cake be paired with multiple others?
Is the price of a pair computed as the maximum of the sums of each attribute individually, or as the maximum attribute sum after summing the attributes?
Can K be zero, or is it guaranteed to be at least 1 as per constraints?
If N is odd and K = floor(N/2), does that mean we must use all cakes (since 2K = N-1 if N odd, leaving one cake unused)?
Are the pairs ordered (i.e., is pair (a_i, b_i) considered different from (b_i, a_i))?
